title: Contracts & Legal
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El inglés legal es complejo, pero ahora puedes leer contratos, identificar 'loopholes' (vacíos legales) y discutir acuerdos corporativos con total seguridad. ¡Nadie se aprovechará de ti en una negociación!

parts.visual:
Términos Clave de Contratos: 
- Binding (Vinculante / Obligatorio por ley). 
Ej: This contract is legally binding. 
- Breach of contract (Incumplimiento de contrato). 
Ej: If you don't deliver the goods, it is a breach of contract. 
- Loophole (Vacío legal / Ambigüedad en la ley que permite evitar una obligación). 
Ej: Their lawyers found a loophole to avoid paying taxes.
parts.audio: Key Contract Terms. 'Binding' means that an agreement is legally mandatory. For example: This contract is legally binding. A 'Breach of contract' occurs when someone fails to do what they promised in an agreement. For example: If you don't deliver the goods, it is a breach of contract. A 'Loophole' is an ambiguity or inadequacy in the law or a set of rules. For example: Their lawyers found a loophole to avoid paying taxes.

parts.visual:
Responsabilidad y Condiciones: 
- Liability (Responsabilidad legal o financiera por algo). 
Ej: The company accepted full liability for the accident. 
- Clause (Cláusula / Una sección específica de un contrato). 
Ej: We need to add a confidentiality clause. 
- Null and void (Nulo y sin valor / Que no tiene fuerza legal). 
Ej: Because it was not signed, the agreement is null and void.
parts.audio: Liability and Conditions. 'Liability' refers to the state of being legally responsible for something, especially financially. For example: The company accepted full liability for the accident. A 'Clause' is a specific section or provision in a legal document. For example: We need to add a confidentiality clause. 'Null and void' means having no legal force or being invalid. For example: Because it was not signed, the agreement is null and void.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término legal o contractual correcto.

questions.question: Once both parties sign this document, it becomes legally ____. (Vinculante / Obligatorio).
Failing to pay on time is a ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento).
questions.explanation: Breach of contract = incumplimiento de contrato.

questions.question: They didn't break the law, but they used a tax ____ to pay almost nothing. (Vacío legal).
The company denies any ____ for the damage caused by the defective product. (Responsabilidad legal/financiera).
questions.explanation: Liability = responsabilidad legal, económica o civil.

questions.question: Because the contract was signed by a minor, it is completely ____ and void. (Nulo).
questions.explanation: Null and void = nulo y sin valor legal.

questions.question: Please review ____ 4.2 regarding confidentiality. (Cláusula).
questions.explanation: Clause = cláusula, sección de un contrato.

questions.question: Before signing, our lawyers need to ____ the contract. (Redactar / Preparar el borrador).
questions.explanation: To draft a contract = redactar/escribir el borrador de un contrato.

questions.question: They threatened to ____ us if we didn't pay the compensation. (Demandar / Llevar a juicio).
We signed an NDA, which stands for Non-____ Agreement. (Acuerdo de confidencialidad).
The court ordered the company to pay $1 million in ____ to the victims. (Daños y perjuicios).
questions.explanation: Damages (en plural, en contexto legal) = daños y perjuicios (compensación económica).

questions.question: If you want to end the contract early, you have to give 30 days' ____. (Aviso previo).
questions.explanation: Give notice = dar previo aviso (de renuncia o cancelación).

questions.question: This agreement is ____ for a period of one year. (Válido / Vigente).
The fine print in the terms and ____ can be tricky to read. (Condiciones).
questions.explanation: Terms and conditions (T&C) = términos y condiciones.

questions.question: We decided to settle out of ____ to avoid a public trial. (Llegar a un acuerdo extrajudicial).
questions.explanation: Settle out of court = llegar a un acuerdo fuera de los tribunales.

questions.question: The contract will ____ on December 31st. We need to renew it. (Vencer / Expirar).
Any dispute will be resolved through ____ instead of going to trial. (Arbitraje).
questions.explanation: Arbitration = arbitraje (resolución privada de disputas legales).

questions.question: The party that signs a contract is sometimes referred to as the ____. (Parte firmante).
questions.explanation: Signatory = la parte que firma un acuerdo.

questions.question: There is a non-____ clause that prevents you from working for our rivals for two years. (No competencia).
questions.explanation: Non-compete clause = cláusula de no competencia.

questions.question: The company filed a ____ against their competitor for patent infringement. (Demanda).
You must ____ with all local labor laws. (Cumplir / Acatar).
Legally ____. (Vinculante con B)
A ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento con B)
A tax ____. (Vacío legal con L)
Legal ____. (Responsabilidad con L)
____ and void. (Nulo con N)
A confidentiality ____. (Cláusula con C)
To ____ a contract. (Redactar con D)
They will ____ us. (Demandarnos con S)
To give 30 days' ____. (Aviso previo con N)
Settle out of ____. (Extrajudicial / Fuera del tribunal con C)
